cross-posted from: https://lemmy.today/post/63107763
[https://lemmy.today/post/63107763] > I’m looking for something like Snikket or
Prosody, but kids-oriented. I DON’T want my <10 daughter using Meta Messenger
Kids! I’ll tell my friends to setup for their kids, too. I’d have no access to
anything, so it’s secure (mom and dad not snooping per se), but the downside is
minimal parental controls. Though, no one to really add either. > > I’ll host or
pay for it, IDC. It doesn’t seem like there is much out there either. > >
JusTalk seemed nice when I found out but apparently China owned and so no more
secure. I/we need better options!
